reviewer.method: Directly read current notebook task/response/generic-feedback cells and exact teacher-note keys; separate second agent read confirmed the mismatches and variance design uncertainty. This is content/design review only; reviewer identity and independence are not machine-authenticated.

scope: Four recorded Week 1 comparisons only. No lesson edits, source-authenticity recheck, learner responses, timing, learning effect, full-lesson adequacy or contest readiness are established.
learner_evidence: No learner answers, assistance history or fresh retry results were observed.

problem_specific_key.rationale: Reshape is [[2,5],[8,11],[14,17]]; transpose is [[2,11],[5,14],[8,17]]. Both shapes are (3,2); [0,1] is 5 versus 11. Transposed first row maps to original first column; memory ownership is not inferred.

feedback.rationale: Reshape is [[2,5],[8,11],[14,17]]; transpose is [[2,11],[5,14],[8,17]]. Both shapes are (3,2); [0,1] is 5 versus 11. Transposed first row maps to original first column; memory ownership is not inferred. These are task-specific answer/explanation and error-checking materials, not evidence that actual feedback was delivered or effective. Generic c85 recommends a changed-input retry but supplies no completed learner retry.

independent_assessment.rationale: Task asks for all predicted values before execution, a differing position, counterexample and axis explanation; response asks for help disclosure. Teacher instructions hide completed examples and key first. Operations are supplied, so the reviewed design is independent prediction/explanation of mapping, not independent invention or selection of an unknown operation. Actual independent learner performance remains unobserved.
